title: musical instruments
description: this project adds musical instruments that can be used as swords and achievements
body:
The mod adds musical instruments that can be used as swords, but you can't play them. It also adds a profession for villagers called "Musician." The purpose of this mod is to provide players with more weapons and content. The mod introduces new instruments, a new profession for villagers, and new challenges. However, the mod's features are limited to new instruments. Players may want to download this mod because they want more content in the game. Please note that the mod may not work well and may have bugs.

presence of weapons:
1. Guitar
2. Trumpet
3. Cymbals
4. Drum
5. Flute.
